profile: Zhou Wenqing (周文庆) controls Shengde Xintai, a Changzhou-based maker of carbon, alloy and stainless seamless steel tubes used largely in ultra-supercritical thermal power boilers, listed on Shenzhen's ChiNext. He is the company's legal representative and largest individual shareholder.
interesting_fact: Shengde Xintai's high-alloy tubes (e.g. T91/T92 grades and super stainless steel) go into ultra-supercritical coal-power boilers, a niche relevant to the energy sector.
notes: Chairman title not confirmed in sources read; ownership from https://quote.cfi.cn/gdtj/93501/300881.html. Route via company board office/IR.

name: Yue Lei
current_role: Senior Vice President, Sanpower Group (Nanjing) as of 2017; current role unknown
profile: Yue Lei (岳雷) appears on Hurun China 2015-2016 tied to Sanpower Group, the Nanjing conglomerate founded by Yuan Yafei spanning IT retail, property, healthcare and investments. As a senior VP he was a spokesman for Sanpower's 2014-2017 overseas buying spree (House of Fraser, Brookstone, Natali, China Cord Blood).
interesting_fact: In a 2017 interview he described Sanpower's foreign acquisitions beyond House of Fraser: US gadget retailer Brookstone, Israel's largest home-care firm A.S. Nursing and senior-care provider Natali, and NYSE-listed China Cord Blood.
deep_cut_fact: He told China Economic Weekly that the wildlife-conservation fund Sanpower co-launched in 2015 with Prince William (the first such tie-up between the British royals and a Chinese company), and its early results in Africa, put Sanpower on the radar of UK society and NGOs.
notes: Identity match is by name + company only (Hurun lists him with Sanpower; a 2017 interview names a Sanpower SVP Yue Lei). Very low profile; no bio found. Sanpower hit a debt crisis from 2018, so his current status is unclear. Weak fit for energy focus.

name: Xuan Ruiguo
current_role: Former actual controller and chairman of Guangdong Huatie Tongda High-speed Railway Equipment (*ST华铁, 000976, now delisted). I could not confirm a current title.
profile: Xuan Ruiguo (宣瑞国) built a rail-equipment business supplying China's high-speed train programme (Huatie Tongda) and earlier chaired Hong Kong-listed China Automation Group, a provider of safety and critical-control systems. He resigned from the Huatie board in 2024, and the company was later delisted. He appeared on the Hurun China list 2010-2020.
interesting_fact: Before the high-speed rail venture, he chaired China Automation Group, an industrial safety and critical-control systems company listed in Hong Kong.
notes: Caution: a 2024 SZSE disciplinary decision names him as actual controller and former chairman of Huatie Tongda, and the listed company has been delisted. He is a poor outreach candidate, and I found no published contacts.

name: Ye Yumei
current_role: Co-founder (with Mao Huixin) of Zhejiang Unifull Industrial Fibre (尤夫股份, SZSE: 002427); not on the company's current board
profile: Ye Yumei (叶玉美) shared a 2010 Hurun listing with Mao Huixin as the founding shareholders of Zhejiang Unifull, a Huzhou-based maker of polyester industrial yarn and dipped cord fabric that listed in Shenzhen in 2010. Unifull has since changed control and management; Ye is not among its current leadership, and no current public role was found.
interesting_fact: Unifull describes itself as China's only producer covering the full polyester industrial-yarn value chain, and opened US and European branches in 2012 and 2015.
notes: No longer connected to Unifull's management per current filings, so the company board office (bs@unifull.com) is not a route to her. No personal public channels found. Very private; probably not worth pursuing.

name: Xu Xiaoguang
current_role: Chairman & General Manager, Xiamen Hexing Packaging Printing Co., Ltd. (合兴包装, 002228.SZ)
profile: Xu Xiaoguang (许晓光, b. 1967, MBA) has led Xiamen Hexing Packaging since 2007, building one of China's largest corrugated-carton and packaging-solutions groups (listed 2008). He and family members (Lv Xiuying, Xu Xiaorong, Xu Tianjin) are the controlling holders via Xinjiang Xinghuiju.
interesting_fact: Hexing supplies corrugated boxes and integrated packaging services to big consumer and electronics brands across China, and he has chaired it continuously since January 2007.
deep_cut_fact: Before packaging, he worked as a forecaster (预报员) at the Civil Aviation Administration of China's Xiamen air-traffic-control station, then ran Lianyu Packaging Industry Co.
notes: Resume taken from the company's filed officer bio (via Eastmoney F10). Best route is the IR department.

name: Zhu Xinghuo
current_role: Director, Shenzhen Goodix Technology Co., Ltd. (SHSE: 603160)
profile: Long-serving director (~13 years) and ~2.4% shareholder (about 11M shares) of Goodix, the Shenzhen fabless chip designer founded in 2002 by Zhang Fan, best known for fingerprint sensors used by Huawei, Xiaomi, OPPO and vivo.
interesting_fact: Goodix's fingerprint-recognition chips were adopted by most major Chinese smartphone brands.
notes: Co-founder status not verified from sources found; described as director/major shareholder.

name: Su Zhi
current_role: Chairman, General Manager and core technical staff, Guangzhou Fangbang Electronics (SH:688020)
profile: Su Zhi (b. 1973), a chemical-process graduate of Dalian University of Technology with an SJTU master's in electrical engineering, spent a decade as a PCB engineer before founding Fangbang in 2010; it makes electromagnetic-shielding films and copper foils for flexible circuits and listed on the STAR Market in 2019. Hurun listed him with Li Dongmei.
interesting_fact: He founded Fangbang in December 2010 after 13 years in PCB/plating engineering and took it public on Shanghai's STAR Market in 2019.
deep_cut_fact: His first job (1997-98) was as an electroplating process engineer at the China Academy of Space Electronics Technology (中国空间电子技术研究所).
notes: Technical founder; electronics materials supply chain.

name: Li Dongmei
current_role: Listed with Su Zhi as owner of Fangbang (computer accessories) on the Hurun China list (2019-2020), presumably Guangzhou Fangbang Electronics (方邦股份), a maker of electromagnetic-shielding films. Current role not verified.
profile: Li Dongmei (李冬梅) appeared on the Hurun China Rich List in 2019-2020, sharing about $340M with Su Zhi, from Fangbang. That is presumably Guangzhou Fangbang Electronics (方邦股份), which listed on Shanghai's STAR Market in 2019 and makes EMI-shielding films for smartphones and flexible circuits. This was not verified in this session.
notes: The company identification is unverified (web-search budget exhausted). A common name: zh.wikipedia's 李冬梅 page is not about her. A STAR Market listing would publish a board-secretary email in its annual report.

name: Tan Guoying
current_role: Major shareholder and former Chairwoman/controlling shareholder, Guangdong Huafeng New Energy Technology (Shenzhen: 002806)
profile: Tan Guoying led Huafeng, founded in 1995 in Zhaoqing, Guangdong as an electronic aluminium foil maker (etched and formed electrode foil for aluminium electrolytic capacitors), and took it public in Shenzhen. Under her it added EV electric-drive and control systems via subsidiary BIT Huachuang. In Nov 2025 she agreed to transfer control to Chen Yun, who became chairman in 2026.
interesting_fact: Huafeng was one of China's earliest specialist makers of low-voltage formed aluminium foil, a key capacitor material, and has been rated among China's top 100 electronic-component companies since 2008.
deep_cut_fact: Huafeng diversified from capacitor foil into EVs through BIT Huachuang (Lihua Huachuang), a Beijing Institute of Technology-linked unit that won Beijing science-and-technology progress awards (1st prize 2014, 2nd prize 2015) for vehicle powertrain and control technology.
notes: Control change: per company announcements (https://basic.10jqka.com.cn/002806/event.html) she agreed in Nov 2025 to sell 16% and delegate remaining votes to Chen Yun, who is now chairman; the company email may no longer reach her. Very low public profile; Chinese-language outreach advisable.

name: Shen Wanqiu
current_role: Founder, director and General Manager, Beijing Highlander Digital Technology (SZSE: 300065); chairman until October 2025
profile: Shen Wanqiu (申万秋), born 1970, has a Tsinghua MBA and worked at China Post & Telecom Industry Corp and Tsinghua's university-enterprise cooperation committee. In 2001 he founded Highlander, which started with ship voyage-data recorders and grew into smart-ship and ocean-observation systems. It is now best known for building China's first commercial underwater data centre, with a version powered by offshore wind.
interesting_fact: Highlander completed China's first commercial underwater data centre off Hainan in 2022, cooled by seawater at a PUE of 1.15 or lower. It then launched a 'subsea data centre plus offshore wind' design in Shanghai Lingang, claiming 95% direct wind-power supply; the Hainan pods host a 675 PFlops AI compute cluster.
deep_cut_fact: He was named one of Tsinghua MBA's '20 People in 20 Years', and his company's systems served China's first aircraft carrier. Highlander's subsea data centre also won the UN Industrial Development Organization's first carbon-neutral technology leading-project award in 2022.
notes: Top fit for the podcast: underwater data centres powered by offshore wind. The Tsinghua MBA honour and the aircraft-carrier detail come from his Sina Finance resume and the company's founder statement (http://www.highlander.com.cn/speech.html). Lu Yaozu replaced him as chairman in October 2025, but he remains GM and a director. Web search quota ran out mid-lane; all facts come from the company site and filings.

name: Hao Hongfeng
current_role: Founder and chairman, Jiuxian Group (Jiuxian.com liquor e-commerce and retail)
profile: Hao Hongfeng founded Jiuxian.com, one of China's main online liquor retailers (a Hurun unicorn 2019-21), and now chairs Jiuxian Group. He is moving it from middleman to brand owner: French and Ningxia (Helan Mountain) wineries, own-brand Rongda sauce-aroma baijiu, and 1,000+ 'Jiuxian Super Stores' with a 'famous liquor at only RMB 10 over cost' pitch. He reported 10% growth in Q2 2025.
interesting_fact: In 2014 he called liquor O2O a 'false proposition' and offline stores 'a step backwards' for e-commerce; from 2017 Jiuxian built a network of more than 1,000 physical stores.
deep_cut_fact: He is building a 1,000-mu Jinfenhe distillery in Xinghuacun, Fenyang (Shanxi), betting that 'whoever becomes No.2 in light-aroma baijiu' after Fenjiu 'is the next RMB 10bn brand'.
notes: Media-friendly: gives interviews and keynote speeches, e.g. 'Breaking through 2026' (https://www.digitaling.com/articles/1443441.html). 2014 O2O quote: https://www.qianzhan.com/people/detail/271/140916-c675f465.html. No published personal or press email found; approach via Jiuxian Group PR.

name: Tong Yihong
current_role: Director and major shareholder, Beijing Toyou Feiji Technology (同有科技, 300302.SZ); GM of Beijing Insage (英思杰) Technology
profile: Born 1964, senior engineer with a master's degree. A long-time major shareholder and director of Toyou Feiji, which grew out of Beijing Institute of Technology and calls itself China's first and only listed pure-play enterprise storage vendor (flash, domestic 'self-controllable' storage). He has run Beijing Insage Technology since 2001 and has been trimming his Toyou stake (2026).
interesting_fact: Toyou has focused on data storage for 30+ years, serving 50,000+ customers in government, finance, energy and research; it pivoted toward flash and domestically controlled storage chips/components.
deep_cut_fact: He serves as president of the Guizhou Enterprise Chamber of Commerce in Beijing, alongside his directorships at Toyou, Beijing Shengshi Quanjing and Beijing Tongxiang Anyu.
notes: Storage/data-center relevance is strong. Chairman/founder is Zhou Zexiang; Tong is the No.2 holder. IR email is the company securities office, not his personal channel.

name: Chen Xiaomin
current_role: Chairman, Suzhou Cheersson Precision Industry Group (瑞玛精密, SZSE: 002976)
profile: Chairman of Cheersson, founded in Suzhou New District in March 2012 and listed in Shenzhen in March 2020. It makes precision moulds, metal structural parts and fasteners for cars, 5G telecom equipment and power gear, and has added automotive air-suspension and new-energy battery-structure businesses, with plants in Suzhou, Guangzhou, Mexico and Coventry (UK). Hurun lists him with Weng Rongrong.
interesting_fact: In 2023 Cheersson bought UK firm Pneuride and set up a JV, Pride Auto Technology (Suzhou), which in Nov 2025 rolled out China's first triple-chamber intelligent air-suspension product.
deep_cut_fact: Cheersson's fastener subsidiary invested RMB260m in a plant designed to make 3 billion fasteners a year for 5G telecom gear and EV battery packs, announced in its IPO year, 2020.
notes: Energy-storage/EV battery-structure parts give an energy angle. Company general inbox is the only published email; IR contact is in SZSE filings.

name: Weng Rongrong
current_role: Director, Suzhou Cheersson Precision Industry Group (parent of Suzhou Cheersson Precision Metal Forming, SZSE: 002976)
profile: Weng Rongrong is a director and major shareholder of the Cheersson group in Suzhou, Jiangsu, whose listed arm, Suzhou Cheersson Precision Metal Forming (listed on Shenzhen 2020), makes precision stamped and formed metal parts and moulds, chiefly for automotive and electronics customers. The listed company is chaired by Chen Xiaomin.
notes: Very low public profile; only aggregator role data (https://de.marketscreener.com/insider/RONG-RONG-WENG-A2MWJL/netzwerk ; company: https://simplywall.st/stocks/cn/capital-goods/szse-002976/suzhou-cheersson-precision-metal-forming-shares/management). Route would be the listed company's board secretary office.

name: Fu Lin
current_role: Director and Deputy General Manager, Zhuhai Bojay Electronics Co. (博杰股份, SZSE 002975)
profile: Fu Lin (付林, b. 1971), an electronics test engineer, is a long-time executive and shareholder of Zhuhai Bojay, where he was executive director and sales director from 2005 before becoming deputy GM (2018) and director (2023). Bojay makes automated test and assembly equipment and supplies electrical-test systems for AI/data-center servers.
interesting_fact: Bojay says it supplies server test equipment to Nvidia, Dell, Amazon, Microsoft and Cisco plus Inspur, Alibaba and Tencent, and has built factories in Mexico, Vietnam and the US.
deep_cut_fact: He started his career in 1997 as a product test engineer at TCL-Thomson Electronics in Shenzhen, then worked as a test engineer at a Dongguan electronics factory before joining Bojay.
notes: Good data-center angle (AI server test equipment). Not the chairman (chairman is Wang Zhaochun); Fu is a co-founder/executive. Route via securities dept email.

name: Guo Song
current_role: Chairman and General Manager, UROVO Technology (优博讯, SZSE: 300531)
profile: Guo Song (b. 1965, Singaporean national) leads Shenzhen-based UROVO, a maker of rugged handheld mobile computers, PDAs, barcode scanners and smart POS terminals for logistics, retail and payments. He joined as deputy GM in 2006, rose to chairman and GM, and is one of the company's actual controllers via its Hong Kong holding company.
interesting_fact: UROVO's handheld data terminals are widely used by China's courier and logistics companies for parcel scanning; it is one of the country's main mobile-intelligent-terminal suppliers.
deep_cut_fact: He studied information engineering at Huazhong University of Science and Technology and took a master's in electronic engineering at the National University of Singapore; he was named a 2013 innovation figure of China's logistics technology equipment industry.

public_contacts.value: info@urovo.com (company securities/IR contact per 2025 annual report)

notes: Avoid referencing the March 2025 death of former vice-chair and co-controller Liu Dan. Route via the board secretary (Liu Zhen) at the published IR address.

name: Chen Yihan
current_role: Co-actual controller of UROVO Technology (优博讯, SZSE 300531); director of its Singapore subsidiary UROVO Pte. Ltd.
profile: Chen Yihan (陈弋寒) is a Singapore national and one of the actual controllers of Shenzhen-listed UROVO Technology, alongside chairman and GM Guo Song, with whom her rich-list entry is shared. UROVO makes rugged handheld data terminals (PDAs), smart POS payment terminals and label printers used in logistics, retail and payments. She sits on the board of UROVO's Singapore subsidiary.
interesting_fact: UROVO is a significant Chinese maker of AIDC (automatic identification and data collection) gear, such as the rugged scanners and PDAs used by courier and warehouse staff, and it is expanding overseas through Singapore and US subsidiaries.
notes: Very low public profile; no interviews found. Guo Song is the public face of UROVO. The IR email belongs to board secretary Liu Zhen, as published in the 2025 annual report. Search budget ran out before I could look for a deep-cut fact.

name: Jiang Jiansheng
current_role: Co-founder and employee-representative director, Hundsun Technologies / 恒生电子 (SH600570), Hangzhou
profile: Jiang Jiansheng (蒋建圣) co-founded Hangzhou-based Hundsun Technologies in 1995; it became China's leading provider of trading, wealth-management and core systems software for brokerages, fund managers, banks and insurers. Ant Group has been the controlling shareholder since 2014. He still sits on the board as an employee director.
interesting_fact: Hundsun, which he co-founded in 1995 with Peng Zhenggang and others, is controlled by Jack Ma-affiliated Ant Group, whose CEO sits on its board.
notes: Low personal profile; no personal interview material found within budget. IR inbox is the published route.

name: Wang Chao

profile: Hurun's 2020 list attributes his wealth to Haitian, China's largest soy-sauce and condiment maker, whose long-serving managers hold stakes via Guangdong Haitian Group (55.4% holder). He is not among Haitian's current top-10 named shareholders or chairman (Cheng Xue), so his exact role could not be confirmed.
interesting_fact: Haitian is on the Ministry of Commerce's first list of 'China Time-honoured Brands' (中华老字号).
notes: Common name - identity not established; likely a Haitian Group management shareholder. Search budget exhausted. Low priority.

current_role: Listed by Hurun (2020) in connection with Hongda Blasting; could not verify the current role
profile: Hurun China 2020 linked Wang Yongqing (王永庆) to Guangdong Hongda Blasting, now Guangdong Hongda Holdings (002683.SZ), a mining-services and civil-explosives group. It was founded in 1988 as a Guangzhou government-established blasting engineering company and is chaired by Zheng Bingxu. Wang's role and shareholding were not verified.
interesting_fact: Hongda began in 1988 as Guangdong Hongda Blasting Engineering Co., set up by the Guangzhou municipal government. It now spans civil explosives, mine stripping, blasting design and overseas contracting.
notes: Not to be confused with Taiwan's late Formosa Plastics founder Wang Yung-ching (same Chinese name). Web search budget ran out during this lane, so this is minimal; worth a re-run with Chinese-language search (company filings, Qichacha).

name: Wen Guoliang
current_role: Director (former general manager and vice chairman), Runner (Xiamen) Corp. / 建霖家居 (SSE: 603408)
profile: Taiwanese industrialist (b. 1953) who co-founded Runner (Xiamen) in 1990 and served as its general manager and vice chairman; the company is a major OEM/ODM of kitchen and bath fittings, water purification, air and health-care products with bases in Xiamen, Ningbo, Zhangzhou and Taipei, listed in Shanghai in 2020. He also ran Taiwan affiliate Shilin (仕霖) for 36 years.
interesting_fact: Runner grew from a 1990 Xiamen start-up by Taiwanese founders into a national-level enterprise technology centre and industrial design centre supplying global sanitary-ware brands.
deep_cut_fact: A graduate of Taiwan's Ming Chi Institute of Technology (now Ming Chi University of Technology), he began his career in 1975 as a salesman at Xinbin Manufacturing before joining Taiwan Shilin in 1979, rising from manager to chairman.
notes: Low public profile; bio from listed-company disclosures (Eastmoney F10). Chairman is Chen Daihua.

name: Yan Jinyuan
current_role: Chairman, Guangdong Biolight Meditech (宝莱特, SZSE: 300246)
profile: Yan Jinyuan (燕金元) chairs Biolight, a Zhuhai-based medical-device maker. It was founded in 1993 as a joint venture, became a national industrialisation base for multi-parameter patient monitors in 2003, and listed on the Shenzhen ChiNext board in 2011. It now covers patient monitoring and life support, kidney/dialysis care and home medical devices. Hurun lists him jointly with Wang Shi.
interesting_fact: Biolight began in 1993 as Zhuhai Biolight Electronics, a joint venture. In 2003 China's NDRC designated it the 'national multi-parameter monitor industrialisation base', and it later grew a large haemodialysis business.
deep_cut_fact: Besides running Biolight, he is an associate professor at Xi'an Jiaotong University and a senior engineer, so he is an academic engineer turned industrialist. He has also served as a deputy to the 10th Zhuhai Municipal People's Congress.
notes: The company publishes separate media-cooperation (brand@) and IR emails, so the media email is the best route. Medtech rather than energy. The web-search budget ran out, so his age and current shareholding were not re-verified.

name: Wang Shi
current_role: Co-actual controller and shareholder of Guangdong Biolight Meditech (宝莱特, SZSE: 300246), Zhuhai
profile: Wang Shi (王石, a woman; not the Vanke founder of the same name) is, together with chairman and president Yan Jinyuan, the actual controller of Guangdong Biolight Meditech, a Zhuhai maker of patient monitors, haemodialysis equipment and consumables. She held about 2.5% directly in 2025; in 2026 the controllers transferred about 7% of the company to Zhejiang Quwei Zhihe Holding.
interesting_fact: Biolight (宝莱特) is a Zhuhai-based medical-device maker that expanded from patient monitoring into kidney-dialysis products and services.
notes: Not an operating executive; chairman Yan Jinyuan (Hurun co-listee) is the public face of Biolight and the better podcast target. Do not confuse with Vanke's Wang Shi.

name: Yang Xianjin
current_role: Chairman, president and legal representative, Dongguan Mentech Optical & Magnetic Co. (铭普光磁, SZSE 002902)
profile: Yang Xianjin (杨先进) runs Mentech, a Dongguan maker of optical and magnetic communication components founded in 2008 and listed in Shenzhen; Hurun listed him (with Jiao Caihong) in 2020. Mentech serves 5G/datacom, PV and vehicle markets and has expanded into home energy storage.
interesting_fact: Mentech has branched far beyond components: it sells home energy-storage systems and launched a smart-cycling brand (美碳) building a hardware+software+service ecosystem for cyclists, and runs a ~900 MWh/yr storage plant and rooftop PV at its Dongguan campus.
notes: Low public profile; no personal social media found. Press email is the company's published media-cooperation contact. Board secretary is Wang Nina. Fit: optical interconnect for data centers plus energy storage. Web-search quota ran out, so no deep-cut fact found.

name: Jiao Caihong
current_role: Co-founder and co-actual controller (with husband Yang Xianjin) of Mentech Optical & Magnetic (铭普光磁, SZSE: 002902), Dongguan; former director
profile: Jiao Caihong (filings spell her name 焦彩红) co-founded Mentech in 2008 with her husband, chairman Yang Xianjin; the pair are the company's actual controllers. Mentech makes network magnetics, optical modules/transceivers and telecom power gear, and listed on Shenzhen in 2017. She served as supervisor, then director (2012 to at least 2018); she still holds ~1.8% directly.
interesting_fact: Mentech's products (optical modules, magnetic components, power supplies) sit in telecom and data-center networks; in Nov 2026 Mentech's private placement application was accepted by the Shenzhen exchange.
deep_cut_fact: Per Mentech's 2017 annual report, she was born in July 1981, helped found the original Mentech company (铭普有限) in 2008 and was its supervisor until 2012, when she became a director of the newly formed joint-stock Mentech.
notes: Hurun writes 焦彩虹; every exchange filing uses 焦彩红. Not on the board per the 2025 annual report (published Apr 2026), but still named as co-actual controller. Low public profile; best route is via the board secretary/IR office (ir@mentech.com, company IR, not personal). Data-center angle: optical modules.

name: Yang Zongmeng
current_role: Major shareholder (about 5.1% as of Q3 2026, down from 7.2% in mid-2025) of Shanghai Fudan-Zhangjiang Bio-Pharmaceutical (688505.SH / 1349.HK); no board or management role
profile: Yang Zongmeng is a foreign-national individual investor who has held a large pre-IPO stake in Fudan-Zhangjiang since before its 2019 STAR Market listing. Fudan-Zhangjiang is a Shanghai photodynamic-therapy and nano-drug company known for Ailaxin (艾拉) and the liposomal doxorubicin Libaoduo. He has been gradually selling shares since the lock-up expired in 2023. I found no public biography.
interesting_fact: Fudan-Zhangjiang, in which he is a top-five holder, has no controlling shareholder. It is a pioneer of photodynamic therapy drugs in China (Ailaxin for condyloma and Fumeida for port-wine stains).
notes: He is a passive investor with no executive role, and filings classify him as an overseas natural person. He is reducing his stake. No personal biography or contact is public. Company IR is a weak route.

name: Yao Chengzhi
current_role: Chairman and General Manager, Ningbo Menovo Pharmaceutical (美诺华, SH: 603538); controlling shareholder via Ningbo Menovo Holdings
profile: Born 1974, he heads and controls Ningbo Menovo Pharmaceutical, founded in 2004 and Shanghai-listed. It makes active pharmaceutical ingredients, intermediates and finished drugs, largely for export to regulated markets. He was re-elected to the board in May 2024.
interesting_fact: Menovo is an export-oriented API maker that partners with multinational generic and originator drugmakers for regulated markets in Europe and elsewhere.
deep_cut_fact: Before pharmaceuticals he worked at Ningbo United Group (宁波联合集团) and its import-export arm, a trading background that shaped Menovo's export-led model.
notes: IR email is the board-secretary contact in the 2024 annual report. Low media profile.

name: Zhou Lingen
current_role: Individual top-10 shareholder (~1.8%) of Hundsun Technologies (600570.SH), Hangzhou; no current executive role found
profile: Hangzhou investor listed by Hurun (2020) for his stake in Hundsun Technologies, China's leading maker of trading and core-system software for brokerages, funds and banks (controlled since 2014 by Jack Ma's Zhejiang Rongxin). Filings show him holding ~1.77% (c. 34m shares), one of the largest individual holders.
interesting_fact: Hundsun, which began as Hangzhou Hundsun Software in the 1990s, is the back-office software backbone of much of China's securities industry; in 2014 Jack Ma's personal vehicle paid 3.3bn yuan for its parent, Hundsun Group.
notes: Shareholding per Hundsun filings (shareholder table, 2022-2024). Likely part of Hundsun's founding/early team but not verified from a public source. Very low profile; only corporate IR route found.

name: Zhuo Chuguang
current_role: Director (former chairman and GM), Hubei Jiuliang Co. (formerly Guangdong DP Co., 'DP 久量' LED lighting; SZSE ChiNext: 300808)
profile: Zhuo Chuguang (卓楚光, b. 1973) founded Guangzhou Songle Electronics in 2002, the predecessor of Guangdong DP (Jiuliang), which built the 'DP' brand of portable LED lights and torches sold mainly in emerging markets, and listed on ChiNext in 2019. He and his wife Guo Shaoyan sold their controlling stake in 2023-26 to a Shiyan (Hubei) state-linked investor; he remains a director.
interesting_fact: DP built its brand largely through overseas distribution networks in emerging markets for portable and rechargeable LED lighting, before a Hubei state-backed investor took control and renamed it Hubei Jiuliang.
deep_cut_fact: He holds an EMBA from Cheung Kong Graduate School of Business and served as vice-president of both the Guangdong Lighting Appliance Association and the Guangdong Chaoshan (Teochew) Chamber of Commerce.
notes: Hurun 'DP' = Guangdong DP Co. (久量股份). Has largely exited after selling control; company IR is now run under new owners, so it's a weak route. Hurun listing shared with wife Guo Shaoyan.

name: Guo Shaoyan
current_role: Former co-controlling shareholder (with Zhuo Chuguang) of Guangdong DP Co. / Jiuliang (久量股份, 300808.SZ); control passed to Shiyan SASAC vehicle in 2024

deep_cut_fact: Dongling began in 1979 when villagers of Dongling village, Baoji, acting as a production team, built 16 street-front shop units and opened the 'Jintai District Lianmeng General Services Department' - the seed of what became a RMB 100B+ group.
notes: Sensitive: Dongling Group is in bankruptcy restructuring (2024), and older press covers a 2009 lead-poisoning protest at a group smelter. Current status of Li unclear; no published contacts (group site chinadljt.com appears defunct). Not recommended for outreach.

name: Xue Dingmin
current_role: Chairman, legal representative and co-controlling shareholder (with son Xue Guofei) of Shanxi Sunshine Coking Group (山西阳光焦化集团), Hejin, Yuncheng, Shanxi
profile: Xue Dingmin (薛靛民, b. Jan 1959, Beifangping village, Hejin), the 'Coke King of Shanxi', founded Sunshine Group in 1992. It is now a coal, coke, tar, carbon-black, fine-chemicals and carbon-materials group with its own power plant and rail line (2024 revenue RMB 15.8bn). He and his son control ~82%. Since 2023 Sunshine has been pursuing a Shanghai IPO to raise RMB 4bn.
interesting_fact: In 2006 Sunshine was China's second-largest private-sector taxpayer, and in 2007 the largest. In 2023 Shanxi named it 'chain leader' for the province's carbon-based new-materials industry.
deep_cut_fact: Before Sunshine he worked at Hejin's Laoyaotou coal mine and a glass factory. At 20, in 1979, he quit to start a trucking business. In 1986 he pooled funds to open the Xitie Trading Qingjian coal-washing plant, Sunshine's forerunner.
notes: Hurun 'Sunshine Group' = 山西阳光焦化集团 (not Jiangsu Sunshine). Energy angle: the IPO proceeds target a 3.69 Mt/yr coking project and a coke-oven-gas-to-LNG and ammonia plant. Once the SSE prospectus is public, its board-office contact would be the official route. I could not open SSE PDFs here (bot challenge). He was vice chairman of the Yuncheng CPPCC from 2006. Avoid the safety-incident coverage.

name: Huang Ming
current_role: Founder and chairman, Himin Solar (Dezhou, Shandong) - latest status not verified this session
profile: Born 1958 in Taixing, Jiangsu; trained at China University of Petroleum and worked as an oil engineer before founding Himin Solar, a pioneer of mass-market solar water heaters. He built Dezhou's 'Solar Valley' (from 2007) and, as a 10th/11th NPC deputy, drafted and championed China's 2005 Renewable Energy Law. He holds hundreds of patents.
interesting_fact: He won the 2011 Right Livelihood Award ('Alternative Nobel') for mass-deploying solar thermal technology; he has said 'I have a dream that one day solar industry will be as advanced as IT industry.'
deep_cut_fact: While an engineer at the Petroleum Research Institute of Dezhou, he started his solar work in secret without quitting, funding his early solar research out of his own salary.

public_contacts.value: https://rightlivelihood.org/press-contacts/ (Right Livelihood handles interview requests for its laureates)
http://www.himinsun.com/ (Himin; did not resolve when checked)

notes: Last on Hurun in 2016 (~US$330M); current wealth/role not re-verified (web-search budget exhausted). Right Livelihood Foundation explicitly offers to broker interview requests - best route. Wikipedia lists a Sina blog (blog.sina.com.cn/u/1214555081).

name: Yan Jiying
current_role: Deceased (died of illness in June 2015). Was founder and chairman of Shanxi Sanjia Coal Chemical Group (三佳煤化集团), Jiexiu, Jinzhong, Shanxi
profile: Yan Jiying (闫吉英/阎吉英), from Jiexiu, Shanxi, founded Sanjia Group, a coal-chemical (coking) business that also developed the Mianshan mountain scenic area, Hurun's 'coal, tourism'. He died of illness in June 2015. Per The Beijing News (2017), his death left the group without a settled successor.
notes: DECEASED: per The Beijing News (via Toutiao, July 2017) he died of illness two years earlier, i.e. 2015 (https://toutiao.com/group/6445420466404638990/). Another post dates it to June 2015. Not a podcast candidate. Hurun 'Sanjia' = 三佳 (Jiexiu).

name: Wen Zhanghua
current_role: Controlling shareholder of Meidu Group (美都集团), Deqing, Zhejiang; formerly chairman and controller of Meidu Energy (SSE: 600175, delisted 2020)
profile: Wen Zhanghua (闻掌华), a postgraduate-educated economist, built Meidu Holdings in Deqing, Zhejiang from property into energy. As Meidu Energy, it bought US oil and gas fields in Texas and later expanded into lithium-battery materials and graphene. The listed company was delisted in May 2020 when its shares fell below par.
interesting_fact: A rare Chinese private buyer of US shale-era oil: in 2013 Meidu paid US$135m for Woodbine Acquisition LLC (Eagle Ford area, Texas), then added the Devon and Manti blocks in 2014-15. All three were held by Meidu America Energy (MDAE).
notes: Hurun 'Meidu' = 美都 (Zhejiang). CAUTION: the Shanghai exchange publicly censured him and found him permanently unfit to be a listed-company executive (Aug 2020), and the Zhejiang CSRC fined him in 2021 over undisclosed guarantees. He is unlikely to be receptive to press. No published contact; the listed company's IR channel no longer exists.

name: Yang Yanliang
current_role: Chairman, Shandong Bohui Group (山东博汇集团), as of the 2017 filing. He is former chairman and actual controller of Shandong Bohui Paper (600966).
profile: Yang Yanliang (杨延良) built the Bohui group in Huantai, Zibo, Shandong, into a major paper and board maker (Bohui Paper, SSE: 600966) with chemicals (Shandong/Jiangsu Haili Chemical) and power assets. Bohui Paper is now indirectly controlled by APP's Gold East Paper (金光纸业), so his current holdings centre on the private Bohui Group. Hurun lists him with Li Xiurong.
interesting_fact: Besides paper, his 2017 roles included chairman of Shandong Tianyuan Thermal Power (山东天源热电) and of Shandong Kerun Investment, plus executive director of Jiangsu Haili Chemical. That is an industrial energy and chemicals side to a paper fortune.
notes: Bohui Paper's published IR email (zqb@bohui.com) now belongs to the APP-controlled listed company, not to him, so it is not a good route. I found no published contact for the private Bohui Group. Web search budget was exhausted, so check whether he is still active. Very low public profile.

name: Yang Jin
current_role: Co-founder of Dongyi Risheng Home Decoration Group (东易日盛, SZSE: 002713); not on the current (2026) board or management list
profile: Yang Jin (杨劲) co-founded Beijing-based Dongyi Risheng with Chen Hui in 1997; it became the first home-renovation company listed on China's A-share market (2014) and grew into a national interior-design and fit-out group. Hurun listed the pair 2014-2021. The company's chairman is now Zhang Jianhua, and neither founder appears among its 2026 directors or officers.
interesting_fact: Dongyi Risheng, founded in 1997, was the first Chinese home-decoration (家装) company to list on the A-share market, in 2014.
notes: Appears to have exited management (control/leadership change by 2025-26; not independently confirmed because web-search budget ran out). Company board office dyrs@dyrs.com.cn would not reach her directly. Very private.

name: Li Xinzhou
current_role: Founder, Chairman & Executive Director, China Pioneer Pharma Holdings / Shanghai Pioneer Holdings (1345.HK)
profile: Li Xinzhou (李新洲) founded Pioneer Pharma in Haikou in 1996, building a marketing and promotion platform for imported pharmaceuticals and medical devices in China; it listed on the HKEX main board in 2013. Renamed Shanghai Pioneer Holdings in 2021, it has since added environmental, eye-care, dental-implant and beauty divisions; he remains chairman.
interesting_fact: The group has diversified well beyond drug distribution: it bought Hunan Tiantong Environmental in 2021, Q3 Medical's mainland China rights in 2023, and launched new units (电火时代 in 2024, beauty in 2025, dental implants in 2026).
deep_cut_fact: Before pharma he was an English teacher at the Jianghan Oilfield school (1981-84), then an English translator for CNOOC's South China Sea West company (1984-88), and later worked at Sumitomo's Hainan office.
notes: Hurun pairs him with Wu Qian, who joined the board as a non-executive director in March 2026. The oil-industry early career offers a good hook for an energy podcast. Former Hainan CPPCC member.

name: Wu Qian
current_role: Non-Executive Director, Shanghai Pioneer Holding Ltd (formerly China Pioneer Pharma Holdings, HKEX: 1345)
profile: Co-controlling shareholder of Pioneer Pharma, a Shanghai-based marketer and distributor of imported pharmaceuticals and medical devices in China, together with chairman Li Xinzhou; controls about 845 million shares directly and indirectly; appointed non-executive director in March 2026.
notes: Board appointment reported by secondary source (itiger); check HKEX filing. Route via company secretary / HKEX-listed company IR.

name: Bao Shijin
current_role: Founder and former chairman, Jiangsu SINOJIT Wind Energy Technology (SH:601218); no board seat listed after Dec 2023
profile: Bao Shijin (b. 1959), a senior economist, founded Jiangyin Jixin Machinery in 2003, which became Jiangsu Jixin Wind Energy (SINOJIT), a maker of large castings for wind turbines, listed in Shanghai. He chaired it from 2008 to April 2021 and then served as a director until late 2023.
interesting_fact: He was named an Excellent National Entrepreneur of the foundry industry (2010) and was a vice-chairman of the Jiangsu Renewable Energy Industry Association.
deep_cut_fact: He was a standing director of the China Foundry Association and in 2009 received the national 'Outstanding Entrepreneur of the Machinery Industry' award for 2007-08.
notes: Hurun labels industry 'solar equipment' but the company makes wind-turbine castings. Strong fit for energy podcast. Current status after leaving the board not confirmed.

name: Qu Quanda
current_role: Chairman of Shanxi Hongsheng Energy Development & Investment Group (山西宏盛能源开发投资集团), Liulin county, Lüliang, Shanxi (registries: chairman, with controlling stakes via Shanxi Fulin Investment and Lüliang Hongsheng Coal & Coke)
profile: Qu Quanda (屈全大), from Qujiagou village in Liulin county, is counted among Liulin's best-known coal bosses. He founded Hongsheng Energy (est. 2006), a private coal and coking group whose assets include the Liulin Hongsheng Jude coal mine, formed in 2009 Shanxi coal consolidation by merging nine smaller mines. Hurun listed him 2013-2016 under 'Hongsheng'.
interesting_fact: In July 2021 Hongsheng gave RMB 10m to Henan flood relief, the largest gift in a RMB 24m batch from Shanxi private firms. That October it gave RMB 5m more to flood-hit Xiaoyi in Shanxi.
deep_cut_fact: The group's Jude mine (柳林宏盛聚德煤业) was created under Shanxi's 2009 coal-mine consolidation order (晋煤重组办发[2009]33号) by merging the former Liulin Jucai coal mine and eight others, with Hongsheng as the lead company.
notes: Hurun 'Hongsheng' = 山西宏盛能源 (Liulin), not Jincheng's Hongsheng construction (宏圣). The legal representative of the group is now Yang Guobing, with Qu listed as chairman. Registry data show consumption-restriction and court flags on the group; financial stress is possible. Unlisted; no published contact (the mine site hsjdmy.cn was unreachable from here).

name: Shu Cecheng
current_role: Listed as owner of Wuzhou International (commercial real estate) on the Hurun China list (2012-2015), presumably founder/chairman of Wuzhou International Holdings (HKEX: 1369), a Wuxi-based wholesale-market developer. Current role not verified.
profile: Shu Cecheng (舒策城) appeared on the Hurun China Rich List from 2012 to 2015 with about $330M from Wuzhou International, a Hong Kong-listed developer of specialised wholesale and commercial complexes in Chinese cities. His current role and the company's status were not verified in this session.
notes: Off Hurun since 2015, and the company's current status is unknown. Verify via HKEXnews before outreach. Web-search budget was exhausted. Real estate, so a weak podcast fit.

name: Wang Zhiqin
current_role: Chairman and General Manager, Jinhong Fashion Group Co., Ltd. (formerly V.GRASS / Vgrass Fashion; SSE: 603518), Nanjing
profile: Wang Zhiqin (王致勤), born 1964, worked at Nanjing No. 2 Steel Plant and then traded on his own before founding Nanjing Jincao Garment Factory in 1996. Its upmarket womenswear brand V.GRASS became Vgrass Fashion, which listed in Shanghai in 2014 and was renamed Jinhong Fashion Group in 2019. He has been chairman and GM since 2010, re-elected in September 2025; Hurun co-lists Song Yanjun, the long-time design director.
interesting_fact: He started out as a steelworker: he spent 1986 to 1992 at Nanjing No. 2 Steel Plant before switching to fashion and building one of China's listed premium womenswear groups.
deep_cut_fact: V.GRASS was co-built with Song Yanjun, who left her job at the Nanjing Electric Power Instrument Factory (1980 to 1994) to become the design director of their small Jincao garment factory in 1996, a role she held through the IPO.
notes: Web search quota ran out mid-lane; data comes from Sina Finance filings. The group also owns other brands (I could not verify the details here). Weak fit for the energy theme; the steel-plant-to-fashion founder story is the hook.

name: Song Yanjun
current_role: Co-controlling shareholder (about 15.35%) of Jinhong Fashion Group (SSE: 603518, formerly V·GRASS / Weigenasi), Nanjing
profile: Song Yanjun co-founded Nanjing Jincao Fashion in 2003 with Wang Zhiqin (chairman and GM), and it became the V·GRASS women's-wear group. Listed in Shanghai in Nov 2014 (37m shares at RMB 20.02), it was renamed Jinhong Fashion and now also owns Teenie Weenie and a Yunjin brocade line. She and Wang are joint actual controllers.
interesting_fact: The group grew from a single women's-wear label into an owner of the Teenie Weenie men's, women's and kids' brand plus Nanjing Yunjin brocade products.
deep_cut_fact: When the predecessor company was set up on 14 March 2003 with RMB 2m registered capital, she contributed RMB 570,000 (28.5%) alongside Wang Zhiqin's RMB 1.2m.
notes: Not a listed executive in current filings; Wang Zhiqin (a former Nanjing No.2 Steel Works employee) is the public face. Route via the board secretary's office. Not a natural energy/data-centre fit.

name: Ji Defa
current_role: Founder and former chairman, Shanghai Step Electric (新时达, 002527.SZ); founding family remains a large shareholder after selling control to Haier's Kaos Industrial Intelligence in 2025
profile: Born 1951, automation engineer (Shandong University of Technology postgraduate, PKU EMBA). Founded Step Electric in Shanghai in 1995; it grew from elevator control systems into servo drives, inverters and industrial robots and listed in Shenzhen in Dec 2010. In 2025 the family transferred shares and delegated voting rights to Haier's Kaos Industrial Intelligence, which became controlling shareholder.
interesting_fact: Step Electric became a national robot-standards body member and vice-chair of the China Robot Industry Alliance, evolving from elevator controllers into one of China's domestic industrial-robot makers.
deep_cut_fact: From 1968 to 1992 he worked at the Yancheng Power Machinery Plant, a Lianyungang chemical-mining design institute and a Shanghai housing-equipment factory, then ran Pudong Shida Elevator Control's development department (1992-95) before founding Step. He was named a Shanghai Model Worker in 2007.
notes: Alive as of Feb 2025 when he signed the share-transfer agreement with Haier Kaos (http://static.cninfo.com.cn/finalpage/2025-06-26/1223981724.PDF). Company is now Haier-controlled, so IR is an indirect route. Robotics/automation angle is relevant.

profile: Zhou Judong built Xinjiang Haoyuan Natural Gas, a natural-gas distribution and CNG business in Xinjiang that listed in Shenzhen in 2012, and appeared on the Hurun China Rich List (2014-2018) together with Di Rong. He served as a director and was named the company's responsible person in its 2019 annual report.

current_role: Co-owner (with husband Zhou Judong) of Aksu Shengwei Industrial Investment (阿克苏盛威实业), former controlling holder of Xinjiang Haoyuan Natural Gas (SZSE: 002700); no listed-company role found

deep_cut_fact: Haoyuan's 2012 IPO prospectus names Di Rong as legal representative of Aksu Jiayuan Property Services (阿克苏佳园物业), a family-owned property-management and leasing firm at 14 Tuanjie East Road, Aksu.
notes: Confirmed via the 2012 IPO prospectus: '周举东与狄蓉为夫妻关系'. Since the change of control, the listed company (now 万憬能源 / Xinjiang Wanjing Energy, contact wjny@002700.cn) no longer represents her, so no contact listed. Very private, no public profile; any approach would have to go through Zhou Judong's Shengwei group in Aksu. Searched Chinese/English web, Baidu (blocked), and SZSE filings.

name: Xiao Wei
current_role: Chairman, Jiangsu Kanion Pharmaceutical Co. (康缘药业, SSE: 600557), Lianyungang; Academician, Chinese Academy of Engineering
profile: Scientist-entrepreneur with a PhD in Chinese materia medica who chairs Kanion, a large modern traditional-Chinese-medicine maker with 61 approved new TCM drugs, 800+ invention patents and 27 exclusive drugs on China's national reimbursement list. He has researched TCM drug creation, process quality control and intelligent manufacturing for 40+ years and has been a National People's Congress deputy in four consecutive terms (11th-14th).
interesting_fact: He is both a listed-company chairman and an academician of the Chinese Academy of Engineering, and served as chief scientist on a national '973' basic-research programme.
deep_cut_fact: He directs China's National Key Laboratory for TCM pharmaceutical process control and intelligent manufacturing, is an executive member of the Chinese Pharmacopoeia Commission, and won the Ho Leung Ho Lee Foundation science and innovation prize and the Guanghua Engineering Science and Technology Prize.

name: Zeng Shaoqiang
current_role: Vice Chairman, Hybio Pharmaceutical (翰宇药业, SZSE 300199); Chairman, Hybio Holdings
profile: Zeng Shaoqiang (曾少强, b. 1971) co-built Shenzhen-based Hybio Pharmaceutical, a peptide-drug specialist covering APIs through finished formulations (including GLP-1 peptide products), alongside chairman Zeng Shaogui. He is vice chairman and also chairs Hybio Holdings.
interesting_fact: Hybio has built a full peptide-drug chain from API to formulation and works on GLP-1 analogues, oncology peptides and peptide vaccines.
deep_cut_fact: He holds a global management doctorate from a Tsinghua SEM/University of Minnesota programme, a Tsinghua MBA and a CKGSB EMBA, and serves as chairman of the Bao'an District Federation of Industry and Commerce in Shenzhen.
notes: Pharma, not energy. Politically connected (former Guangdong CPPCC standing committee member, Shenzhen People's Congress deputy).

name: Zhong Faping
current_role: Founder and actual controller of Hunan Corun New Energy (科力远, SSE: 600478); former chairman
profile: Zhong Faping (钟发平, b. 1965) founded Corun in 1998 in Hunan to make advanced battery materials and nickel-metal-hydride batteries; it listed in Shanghai in 2003 and now spans battery minerals, materials, hybrid-vehicle batteries, energy-storage systems and recycling. He remains its actual controller (direct ~6% plus holding company), with Geely as a major shareholder.
interesting_fact: Corun hosts a National Engineering Research Center for Advanced Energy Storage Materials approved by China's NDRC and has won two National Science & Technology Progress second prizes for its battery work.
deep_cut_fact: A chemist by training from Taoyuan County, Hunan, he graduated in chemistry from Wuhan University and served as a deputy to both the 11th and 12th National People's Congress (from 2008).
notes: No longer chairman (current chairman Zhang Judong) but still controlling shareholder. Hurun listing last 2021. Alive status inferred from his continuing shareholder/controller status in 2026 filings. Route via Corun board office.

name: Li Yuhu
current_role: Executive Director and GM, Xinjiang Maiquer Group (parent of Maiquer Group Co., SZSE: 002719); co-actual controller
profile: Li Yuhu heads the family that controls Xinjiang-based Maiquer Group, a dairy and bakery/food company listed in Shenzhen. He and his wife Wang Cuixian, with sons Li Yong (chairman) and Li Gang (GM), are its ultimate controllers; he is executive director and GM of the parent, Xinjiang Maiquer Group.
interesting_fact: Maiquer is one of Xinjiang's best-known home-grown food brands, combining dairy (milk) with bakery and festive foods such as mooncakes.
notes: Day-to-day leadership has passed to his sons; the listed company carries 'ST' status, so avoid financial topics. Route via the board office (bod@maiquer.com).

name: Ni Mingjing
current_role: Chairman, legal representative and ~90% owner of Inner Mongolia Shanlu Energy Group (内蒙古山路能源集团), Tumed Right Banner, Baotou (per business registries)
profile: Ni Mingjing (倪明镜) controls Shanlu Energy Group, a Baotou-area private group founded around 2002 with roughly 80 member companies. It spans coal mining and trading in Tumed Right Banner and solar/silicon manufacturing through Baotou Shansheng New Energy, plus solar ventures in Shanghai, Hohhot and Golmud (Qinghai). Hurun's 'Shanlu (coal, solar)' listing matches this group (2014-2015).
interesting_fact: Shanlu is an early coal-to-solar crossover. Its Baotou Shansheng New Energy (est. 2004) operates silicon production at the Tumed Right Banner industrial park, and the group set up solar-power and solar-tech units in Qinghai, Shanghai and Hohhot.
notes: Hurun 'Shanlu' = 内蒙古山路能源集团 (Baotou). Identity rests on business-registry data (aiqicha/qixin); no press profile, interview or official website found in Chinese/English searches. Registries show equity freezes (2023), enforcement flags and search hints of court reward notices, so the group appears financially distressed. Approach with care, or not at all. No published contact.

name: Hou Xiaomei
current_role: Co-owner (with husband Wang Xueqing 王学清, chairman) of Shandong Shouguang Luqing Petrochemical (山东寿光鲁清石化), Shouguang, Shandong
profile: Hou Xiaomei (侯效梅) and her husband Wang Xueqing, founder, controlling shareholder and chairman of Luqing Petrochemical, were listed together on Shandong/Hurun rich lists (2014-2017). Luqing is a privately held 'teapot' refiner and petrochemical group in Shouguang making LPG, propylene, polypropylene, MTBE, asphalt and fuels; its revenue was about RMB 62bn in 2023.
interesting_fact: Luqing was Weifang's second-largest private company by revenue (~RMB 62.2bn) and ranked 20th in Shandong; it joined China's top-500 private companies in 2013.
deep_cut_fact: Before its 2000 conversion from a township collective into a private firm, Luqing was a little-known asphalt plant (Shouguang Guangyuan Industrial) with 32 employees and about RMB 3m a year in revenue; it was later renamed from 'Luqing Waterproof Building Materials'.
notes: Input spelling 'Wang Xueqing' is 王学清 (not 王学庆), the legal representative and chairman. Rich lists name the couple 王学清、侯效梅夫妇 (e.g. https://m.chyxx.com/top/201610/456845.html). Business-registry aggregators also show her as a Luqing shareholder. Her own role is low-profile; no published personal contact. Approach via Luqing's corporate office in Shouguang. Luqing is unlisted, so no IR channel.

name: Cao Baohua
current_role: Chairman of the Board and President, Chunfeng Industrial Group (春风实业集团), Hebei
profile: Cao Baohua (曹宝华, born April 1955, from Jizhou, Hebei) is the entrepreneur behind Chunfeng Industrial Group, a privately held Hebei equipment-manufacturing group. He chairs it and serves as president. He has also been a long-serving deputy to China's National People's Congress for Hebei.
interesting_fact: He was elected a Hebei deputy to five consecutive National People's Congresses (the 9th through the 13th), which is unusually long for a private entrepreneur.
deep_cut_fact: He studied through the correspondence college of the Central Party School rather than a conventional university.
notes: Identity is from Chinese Wikipedia, which cites NPC deputy records. Chunfeng Industrial Group (Hebei) is unrelated to CFMOTO (春风动力). Unlisted company, so there are no filings or IR contacts; I found no verified official website. He would be about 71.

name: Dai Yusen
current_role: Managing Partner, ZhenFund (真格基金), Beijing
profile: Dai Yusen (戴雨森) co-founded cosmetics e-commerce platform Jumei (聚美优品), which reached RMB10bn in annual revenue and listed on the NYSE in 2014. He later joined early-stage VC ZhenFund, where as managing partner he has led bets on AI companies including Moonshot AI (Kimi), Manus and Genspark, plus the hit game Party Animals.
interesting_fact: He is one of China's best-known AI investors: ZhenFund lists Moonshot AI, Manus, Genspark, YouWare and Dyna Robotics among the deals he led or joined.
deep_cut_fact: He holds a bachelor's in industrial engineering from Tsinghua and dropped out of Stanford's Management Science & Engineering programme at 22 to start Jumei.
notes: Strong podcast fit: active, media-friendly AI investor and frequent podcast guest/host via ZhenFund's own show. Best route is ZhenFund's general inbox or marketing contact. Personal social accounts not verified within budget.

name: Fu Sheng
current_role: Chairman & CEO, Cheetah Mobile (NYSE: CMCM); Chairman, OrionStar (猎户星空) AI & robotics
profile: Born 1978 in Jingdezhen, Jiangxi. Led Qihoo 360's 360 Safeguard team (2005-08), founded Conew Image in 2009, and in 2010 merged it with Kingsoft Security (backed by Lei Jun) to form what became Cheetah Mobile, listed in New York in 2014. Since 2016 he has pivoted to AI via OrionStar, which builds service robots and LLMs and became a Cheetah subsidiary in December 2023.
interesting_fact: Before Cheetah he was the product lead behind 360 Safeguard (360安全卫士), the free security app that made Qihoo 360 one of China's biggest internet companies; he left in 2008 over differences with Zhou Hongyi, and the two publicly reconciled in 2024.
deep_cut_fact: His first brush with the internet was in 1999 as head of the e-commerce department at Xiamen computer maker Xoceco (厦华电脑), followed by enterprise full-text search work at Guoxin Base and a director role at 3721 (later bought by Yahoo China).
notes: Highly public and media-friendly (frequent speaker and short-video creator on AI). Strong fit for an AI/compute angle via OrionStar. Name sometimes rendered 'Sheng Fu'.

name: Li Baotian
current_role: Listed by Hurun (2014) as owner of 'Tianbao' (housing construction); could not verify the current role
profile: Hurun China 2014 listed Li Baotian (李保田) with wealth from 'Tianbao', a housing-construction business. The specific company could not be verified.

He holds senior roles in Zhejiang's business community, including Standing Committee member of the Zhejiang CPPCC and first executive chairman of the Zhejiang Private Equity Association.
interesting_fact: Named one of Hurun China's Top 50 Best Venture Capitalists (2016) and Forbes China's Top 100 venture capital figures (2018); ZSVC has taken nearly 30 of ~100 portfolio companies to listing or M&A exit.

name: Lai Chunlin
current_role: Chairwoman and General Manager, Hubei Century Network Technology (盛天网络, SZSE: 300494), Wuhan; vice chair, Hubei Federation of Industry and Commerce
profile: Lai Chunlin (赖春临, b. 1977, Hubei) entered internet-cafe software in 2000 and in 2006 co-founded Shengtian (Century) Network, launching the 'Yiyou' (易游) internet-cafe management platform. She took it public on ChiNext in Dec 2015 - Hubei's first listed internet company - and has since expanded into game publishing and IP operations (Tianxi Huyu acquisitions 2019/2021). She owns ~24%.
interesting_fact: Shengtian was the first internet company from Hubei province to list (ChiNext, 2015); Lai was named one of the 'Optics Valley 30 innovators in 30 years'.
deep_cut_fact: Her company's roots are in China's internet cafes: in 2006 she launched 'Yiyou' (易游), a management platform for internet cafes; in 2023 she proposed esports hotels as offline entry points to the metaverse at a Wuhan developer summit.
notes: Hurun's 'Shanda' refers to Shengtian Network (盛天网络), not Chen Tianqiao's Shanda. Active in Hubei business associations; donated RMB1m to Hubei Red Cross in 2020. Formal route via company board office.

name: Lin Rujie
current_role: Founder and Chairman, Fujian Snowman Group (雪人集团, SZSE: 002639); Vice President, Fujian Refrigeration Society
profile: Lin Rujie (林汝捷, b. 1968) founded Changle Snowman Refrigeration Equipment in Fujian in March 2000; it is now Snowman Group, listed in Shenzhen. It makes ice-making systems and industrial refrigeration compressors and has expanded into industrial heat pumps, LNG/oil-and-gas services and hydrogen-energy equipment, including fuel-cell compressors via a Japanese hydrogen-power affiliate.
interesting_fact: Snowman's compressors and ice systems span cold-chain, concrete cooling for dams, mine cooling, energy-storage peak shaving, ice-sports venues and hydrogen equipment, and it runs a dedicated hydrogen unit (Fujian Snowman Hydrogen Technology).

notes: Strong energy angle (hydrogen compressors, heat pumps, LNG services). Probably speaks Japanese. Route via the Snowman board office email.

current_role: Chairman and actual controller, Guangzhou Well Lead Medical Co. (维力医疗, 603309.SH)
profile: Xiang Bin (向彬, b. 1969, Hong Kong resident) has chaired Guangzhou Well Lead Medical since 2011 and is its actual controller via controlling shareholder Gaobo Investment. The Panyu, Guangzhou-based company makes medical consumables, including anaesthesia-related devices, and has been recognised as a manufacturing 'single champion' product enterprise.

name: Ryan Seacrest
current_role: Host of Wheel of Fortune (since Sept 2024); host of American Idol and Dick Clark's New Year's Rockin' Eve; founder, Ryan Seacrest Productions
profile: Atlanta-born TV/radio host and producer. Rose to fame hosting American Idol from 2002, built Ryan Seacrest Productions (Keeping Up with the Kardashians, Jamie Oliver's Food Revolution), co-hosted Live with Kelly and Ryan (2017-23) and replaced Pat Sajak as Wheel of Fortune host in 2024. Also investor in Typo keyboard and Pathwater.

notes: Media personality rather than an energy/tech entrepreneur; foundation contact form is the published route. Also an investor in Pathwater (refillable aluminum-bottle water).

name: Ellen DeGeneres
current_role: Comedian, former host of The Ellen DeGeneres Show (2003-2022); largely retired from show business
profile: Metairie, Louisiana-born (1958) comedian whose breakthrough came via a 1986 Tonight Show appearance, followed by the sitcom Ellen and a 19-season daytime talk show. Her wealth comes from TV, her production company A Very Good Production and the ED Ellen DeGeneres lifestyle brand. After a 2024 Netflix special she said she would retire; she moved to the Cotswolds, England in Nov 2024.
interesting_fact: Before comedy she worked as a law-firm clerk, at J.C. Penney, as a TGI Fridays waitress, house painter, hostess and bartender; Showtime named her its 'funniest person in America' in 1984.
deep_cut_fact: The Ellen DeGeneres Campus of the Dian Fossey Gorilla Fund, a mountain-gorilla research and education campus near Volcanoes National Park in Kinigi, Rwanda, was funded through The Ellen Fund and formally dedicated in June 2022.
notes: Entertainment figure, not a business founder - weak fit for an energy/data-center podcast. Reports in 2026 conflict on whether she has moved back to California (Montecito purchase reported Feb 2026). April 2026 reports said she would voice Dory again in a Finding Nemo short.

name: Katy Perry
current_role: Singer-songwriter and performer; co-founder of non-alcoholic aperitif brand De Soi
profile: Born Katheryn Hudson (1984, Santa Barbara), she became a pop star with 'I Kissed a Girl' (2008) and 'Teenage Dream'. Her wealth comes from music (catalog rights sold to Litmus Music in 2023 for an estimated $225m), touring and ventures such as De Soi (2022). The 2025 Lifetimes Tour played 91 shows grossing $134m+; in 2026 she performed at the World Cup opening ceremony.
interesting_fact: On 14 April 2025 she flew to space on Blue Origin's NS-31, the first all-female spaceflight since 1963.
deep_cut_fact: Her debut was a 2001 gospel album, 'Katy Hudson', recorded at 16 for Red Hill Records; it sold an estimated 200 copies before she took her mother's maiden name, Perry, as a stage name.
notes: Entrepreneurship angle: De Soi (co-founded Jan 2022 with Morgan McLachlan) and an early Popchips investor/spokesperson role. As of Sept 2026 she is working on the animated film 'Melody'. Any approach goes through her management/publicists.

name: Luke Evnin
current_role: Advisor, MPM BioImpact (co-founder of predecessor MPM Capital); board member, Werewolf Therapeutics
profile: Luke Evnin (Princeton A.B. 1985, UCSF biochemistry Ph.D. 1990) spent 1990-97 at Accel Partners, then co-founded life-sciences VC MPM Capital with Ansbert Gadicke in 1997, opening its San Francisco office in 1999. He co-founded and chaired biotechs including Harpoon, Maverick (sold to Takeda), Potenza (Astellas) and Werewolf, where he was interim CEO 2017-19. He is now an advisor at MPM BioImpact.
interesting_fact: He is a co-inventor on patents at several of the biotechs he co-founded, including Oncorus - unusual for a VC.
deep_cut_fact: He has chaired the Scleroderma Research Foundation for 20+ years, sits on the external advisory board of Princeton's Lewis-Sigler Institute for Quantitative Genomics, and is a keen squash and tennis player and wine collector.
notes: info@ is a general firm inbox. Also listed as Werewolf board member (https://investors.werewolftx.com/board-member/luke-evnin-phd). Biotech VC rather than energy; angle could be company-building/science-to-startup.

name: Corbin J Robertson Jr
current_role: Chairman and CEO, Natural Resource Partners L.P. (NYSE: NRP); director, Quintana Minerals and KLX Energy Services
profile: Houston-born (1947) grandson of oilman Hugh Roy Cullen, founder of Quintana Petroleum. He started in the family business at 15, inherited oil holdings and in the 1980s moved into coal royalties, amassing one of the largest private U.S. coal reserves. He leads NRP, a Houston partnership owning mineral and royalty interests (coal, soda ash, carbon-neutral initiatives).
interesting_fact: He was an All-American linebacker at the University of Texas who captained the Longhorns to victory in the 1969 Cotton Bowl Classic.
deep_cut_fact: Racing as 'Saron Stable', he bred Turkoman (by Alydar), voted 1986 Eclipse Award U.S. Champion Older Male, and raced Hall of Fame filly Bold 'n Determined (inducted 1997).
notes: Goes by 'Corby'. Serves on University of Houston Energy Advisory Board; UH has a Corbin J. Robertson Society. Major GOP donor and coal-industry figure: politically sensitive topics. NRP IR contact is the only published route.

name: Steven Ferguson
current_role: Principal of Linton Investments, the Ferguson family investment office (Aberdeenshire, Scotland)
profile: Aberdeenshire entrepreneur who built Kintore-based Ferguson Group (offshore containers, accommodation modules) into a global offshore rental business over three decades, selling it to Brambles in 2014 for ~£320m. Now invests via family office Linton Investments, incl. North Sea services firm Centrifuges Un-Limited (2020).
interesting_fact: Ferguson Group grew from a small North Sea container firm into a global business with a fleet of 16,000+ offshore containers, tanks and baskets, and in 2011 launched its own 220-berth accommodation service vessel, ASV Pioneer.
deep_cut_fact: In 2015 the Ferguson family set up the Inverurie Youth Sports Foundation, which has funded 61 young athletes across 34 sports in the Garioch area - including freestyle skier Kirsty Muir (2022 Winter Olympian) and Tokyo Paralympic finalist swimmer Conner Morrison.
notes: Private family-office figure; best route is Linton Investments' published admin email. Sale-to-Brambles detail per Energy Voice (https://www.energyvoice.com/?p=64838, not directly fetchable here). Energy angle: North Sea services and decommissioning (Centrifuges).

interesting_fact: Rady Children's Hospital and UC San Diego's Rady School of Management bear his name; he and Evelyn pledged $200 million to Rady Children's in 2018 and gave a $30 million lead gift to found the Rady School in 2004.

name: Oliver Cookson

profile: Manchester-born Oliver Cookson founded sports nutrition brand Myprotein in 2004 from a lock-up garage with a £500 overdraft and sold it to The Hut Group in 2011 for £58m cash plus shares. name: Martin H. Nesbitt

notes: Behind-the-scenes co-founder; her husband Samson Lam (VPower CEO) is the more natural podcast guest. Board resignation announced Dec 2023 (https://www1.hkexnews.hk/listedco/listconews/sehk/2023/1205/2023120500101.pdf).

name: Pan Feng
current_role: Co-actual controller (with spouse Zhong Wangjun) of Tianjin Jieqiang Equipment (捷强装备, 300875.SZ); chairman/GM 2015-July 2024, no longer in management
profile: Pan Feng (潘峰, b. 1968) led Jieqiang Equipment, a maker of nuclear-biological-chemical (NBC) defence and safety equipment, as chairman and general manager from 2015 until July 2024, taking it public on Shenzhen's ChiNext. He stepped down from management in 2024 and remains a co-controlling shareholder.
notes: NOT a suitable outreach target: per company disclosure he was placed under investigation in June 2024 and criminally detained in June 2025 on suspicion of unit bribery (https://www.nbd.com.cn/articles/2025-06-26/3922472.html). Defence/military-equipment business, not energy. Recommend skipping.

name: Zhong Wangjun
current_role: Co-founder and one of five actual controllers (~7.4% holder) of Tianjin Jieqiang Power Equipment Co., Ltd. (捷强装备, SZSE: 300875); no current board/executive title confirmed
profile: Zhong Wangjun (钟王军) was a founding cash investor when Tianjin Jieqiang was set up in 2005 and remains one of its five acting-in-concert controllers alongside largest holder Pan Feng. Jieqiang makes nuclear-biological-chemical (NBC) detection, protection and decontamination equipment for China's military, plus new-materials products; it listed on Shenzhen's ChiNext in 2020.
interesting_fact: Jieqiang's core business is NBC security gear (radiation monitors, biological detectors, decontamination systems), and the 'Power' in its name comes from its origins in mobile power-supply vehicles.
deep_cut_fact: Jieqiang was founded on 1 Nov 2005 with RMB 3m of capital: Beijing Jieqiang contributed a utility-model patent for 'a power-supply vehicle' (一种电源车) valued at RMB 2.4m, and Zhong Wangjun put in RMB 444,000 in cash, the largest individual contribution.
notes: Defense-sector company; very low profile. Hurun 'Jieqiang Power' = 天津捷强动力装备. Chairman since July 2024 is Pan Qijing. Energy link is weak (power-supply vehicles origin). Approach via company general email.

name: Tang Hai
current_role: Founder and Chairman, Bondex Supply Chain Management Co., Ltd. (海程邦达, SSE: 603836), Qingdao
profile: Tang Hai (唐海) founded Qingdao-based Bondex (海程邦达), a freight-forwarding and supply-chain logistics group set up in 1996 that listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange main board in 2021. He was chairman and general manager at IPO; the group now has 2,000+ staff, 80+ subsidiaries and covers 200+ ports, with a growing focus on semiconductor/electronics logistics.
interesting_fact: Bondex has pushed into semiconductor supply chains via its JV platform 邦达智联 and presented at the 2026 North American 3PL Value Creation Summit in Chicago; it was ranked 26th among A&A's 2026 Asia-Pacific Top 50 3PLs.
deep_cut_fact: Per the 2021 IPO prospectus summary, Tang has chaired Qingdao Haixinda (青岛海新达) since 2001 and has been vice-chairman of Qingdao port e-platform 青岛港易通 since 2014 - both Bondex associates.
notes: Low public profile; little personal biography online. Best route is the board secretary / securities office. Chinese-language outreach advisable. Not to be confused with Jiangsu Hichain (海晨物流).

name: Tang Yong
current_role: Chairman and legal representative, Maccura Biotechnology Co., Ltd. (SZSE: 300463), Chengdu
profile: Tang Yong (唐勇) is chairman and a major shareholder (about 15%) of Maccura Biotechnology, an in-vitro diagnostics maker founded in Chengdu in 1994. Maccura started as a distributor of diagnostic products and moved into its own R&D and manufacturing. It listed on the Shenzhen ChiNext board in 2015.
interesting_fact: Maccura started out as a distributor and later turned itself into a manufacturer through its own R&D. It is now one of China's leading domestic IVD suppliers.
notes: Low public profile, and I found little personal biography. The ir_email is the securities department address given in Maccura's 2025 sustainability report. The board secretary is Shi Wei. The common name has many namesakes (doctors, professors). Chairman role per https://pitchhub.36kr.com/project/2144728819582214.

name: Wang Dawei
current_role: Co-founder and major shareholder of Shenzhen Gongjin Electronics (603118.SH); former chairman (board reorganised Feb 2026 under Tangshan SASAC control)
profile: Wang Dawei (汪大维) co-founded Shenzhen Gongjin Electronics, a broadband/network-equipment contract manufacturer (PON, Wi-Fi APs, DSL, set-top boxes, switches, servers), with Tang Fonan. He was long-time chairman. In late 2025 Tangshan Industrial Holding (Tangshan SASAC) agreed to take control, and in Feb 2026 Wang Jianxiang became chairman.
interesting_fact: Gongjin is nicknamed a 'little Huawei' in the industry; by 2025 it had shipped 400G data-center switches in volume, trial-produced 800G switches and produced over 30,000 servers, including AI servers.
notes: Hurun wealth is shared with his wife Wang Danhua. Control of Gongjin has passed to Tangshan state capital, so his current operating role is unclear; very low public profile. Data-center angle: the company's server and switch push, plus the new owner's wind assets in Chifeng.

name: Huang Ziwei
current_role: Chairman and General Manager, Uroica Precision Information Engineering Co., Ltd. (SZSE: 300099), Tai'an, Shandong
profile: Huang Ziwei (黄自伟) co-founded and runs Uroica, founded in 1998 in Tai'an and listed on ChiNext in 2010. It makes coal-mine roof and rock-burst safety monitoring systems, explosion-proof monorail mine transport and mining robots, plus defence products. Hurun (2021) listed his fortune jointly with Wang Jinghua.
interesting_fact: Uroica, formerly Uroica Mining Safety Engineering, renamed itself in 2017. It has moved from mine-pressure monitoring into intelligent mine transport (including new-energy monorail cranes and self-driving locomotive systems) and defence electronics.
deep_cut_fact: Before he became an entrepreneur he was an academic: he graduated from Tongji University in 1982 and then became a professor at Shandong University of Science & Technology. That is the mining-engineering background Uroica grew out of.

public_contacts.value: http://www.uroica.com.cn (has investor-relations and 联系我们 contact pages with an inquiry form)

notes: Older executive (mid/late 70s per data sites). He has no English media presence. The best route is a Chinese-language letter through the company board secretary (Du Houke) or the website inquiry form. Company IR phone is +86 538 892 6152 (published listing profile, stockanalysis.com).

name: Wang Zhaochun
current_role: Co-founder, legal representative and co-controlling shareholder of Zhuhai Bojay Electronics (Bojay, SZSE: 002975); chairman per 2025-26 filings/press
profile: Wang Zhaochun (b. 1972) co-founded Zhuhai Bojay Electronics, a maker of automated test and assembly equipment for electronics (Apple-chain supplier), listed in Shenzhen in 2020. He is one of three controlling shareholders acting in concert with Fu Lin and Cheng Jun.
interesting_fact: Bojay's three founders (Wang Zhaochun, Fu Lin, Cheng Jun) jointly control the company as concert parties, holding stakes partly via the Bohang, Bowang and Bozhan investment partnerships that Wang manages.
deep_cut_fact: Before Bojay, Wang worked in a knitting factory and a machinery factory in Zhuhai from 1989 to 1997, then ran his own small machinery-and-mould workshop.
notes: Sources disagree on whether he is still chairman (one profile says chair term ended June 2024; 2025 report lists him as legal representative, 2026 press calls him chairman). Board secretary Huang Can handles investor contact. Chinese-language outreach advisable.

name: Wang Zhenjian
current_role: Chairman, Chongqing Shunbo Aluminum Co., Ltd. (顺博合金, SZSE: 002996)
profile: Wang Zhenjian (王真见, b. 1964) is chairman and co-controlling shareholder (~20.5%) of Shunbo Aluminum, one of China's top-four recycled aluminium alloy producers, with plants in Chongqing, Qingyuan, Liyang, Xiangyang and Anhui. He has 30+ years in scrap-metal recycling; the company listed in Shenzhen in Aug 2020.
interesting_fact: Shunbo is a pure recycled-aluminium (circular-economy) business: it turns scrap aluminium into alloy ingots for auto and motorcycle parts, and produced ~553,000 tonnes of alloy ingot in 2021.
deep_cut_fact: Before Shunbo he worked at the Xilu metal fittings factory in Yongkang, Zhejiang, then ran the Xilu metal processing plant in Chongqing's Jiulongpo district as factory director; he was vice-chairman of Shunbo Ltd from 2008 and chairman since May 2013.
notes: Low public profile; no personal media presence found. Controls company jointly with Wang Zengchao and Wang Qi. Best route is the board secretary via ir@sballoy.com (Chinese-language).

name: Wu Caiping
current_role: Individual top-10 shareholder (~2.6%) of Guangzhou Shiyuan Electronic Technology (CVTE, SZSE: 002841)
profile: Wu Caiping (吴彩平) is a long-standing individual shareholder of CVTE (Shiyuan Electronic), the Guangzhou maker of interactive flat panels, display control boards and the Seewo/MAXHUB brands, listed in Shenzhen in 2017. Wealth comes from that stake (~18.3m shares, ~2.6% as of Sept 2026). Not part of the founders' concerted-action group and holds no disclosed executive role; otherwise very low profile.
interesting_fact: Ranked among CVTE's top 10 shareholders in the 2024 annual report alongside founders Huang Zhengcong, Wang Yiran and Sun Yonghui; CVTE, founded in 2005, is one of the world's largest suppliers of LCD TV main control boards and interactive whiteboards.
notes: Very private passive shareholder; no public interviews found. Only route is CVTE's board-secretary/IR office (email is company IR, not personal). Gender and age not confirmed.

name: Wu Wenqing
current_role: Listed by Hurun (2021) under Gotion High-Tech (国轩高科, Hefei); role unverified
profile: Hurun's 2021 China list gives Wu Wenqing (吴文青) under 国轩高科 (Gotion High-Tech, 'Anhui Guoxuan'), with interests in batteries, real estate, film and investment. Gotion is controlled by founder Li Zhen (李缜) and his concert parties, with Volkswagen China the largest single holder since 2020. No filing or news item naming Wu Wenqing was found.
notes: Hurun API (2021 entry) confirms the company label and industries (电池、房地产、影视、投资). Searches for 吴文青+国轩/国轩控股 found nothing, and no Wu Wenqing appears in Gotion top-holder coverage. Could be a holder of the private Guoxuan Holding group. Low priority.

name: Wu Xiaoliin
profile: Listed on Hurun China 2021 (US$310m) with source of wealth 'Link' (chemical products). Searches could not tie 吴晓林 to a specific company; the likely candidate, Lianhe Chemical Technology (联化科技, 002250.SZ), is chaired by Wang Ping and its public shareholder/executive lists do not show this name.
notes: Identity unresolved: 'Link' company not identified. Do not confuse with a different Wu Xiaolin (b.1981) named on a Hong Kong SFC persons-of-interest list. Needs Hurun original entry to resolve.

name: Wu Xuewei
profile: Listed by Hurun China (2019-2021) with wealth from 'Anto' (pharmaceuticals/diagnostics, likely Zhengzhou Autobio/Antu Bio, SSE: 603658). Web searches could not confirm his role; Autobio's chairman is Miao Yongjun.
notes: Could not verify link between Wu Xuewei and Autobio (Antu) in accessible sources; check shareholder list in Autobio annual reports on cninfo/SSE before outreach. Company-level route: Autobio IR via SSE disclosures.

name: Xia Houjun
current_role: Chairman of the Board, Zhejiang Fulai New Material Co., Ltd. (SSE: 605488)
profile: Founder-chairman of Zhejiang Fulai New Material, a Shanghai-listed maker of functional coating composite materials (self-adhesive labels, films and specialty coated materials). He controls roughly 45% of the shares, which is the source of his wealth.
interesting_fact: Holds about 45.4% of Fulai New Material (around 126 million shares) and has chaired the board for over 16 years.
notes: Very low English-language profile; no published personal or IR contact found in English sources. Best route is likely the company's board secretary / IR contact listed in its Shanghai Stock Exchange annual report (Chinese).

name: Xiao Jian
current_role: Chairman and CEO, CMGE Technology Group (HKEX: 0302)
profile: Xiao Jian (b. ~1980) is co-founder, chairman and CEO of CMGE Technology Group, a Hong Kong-listed Chinese mobile game publisher and IP game operator. Joined CMGE Group as COO in 2011 and became CEO in 2012; CMGE has built its strategy around licensed IP such as Chinese Paladin (Xianjian), Xuanyuan Sword and Monopoly (Da Fu Weng).
interesting_fact: In 2018 CMGE paid RMB213m for 51% of Beijing Softstar (later 100%), securing development rights around classic Taiwanese IPs like Chinese Paladin/Sword and Fairy; Xiao has framed CMGE as an 'IP game operator' spreading Chinese culture via games.
deep_cut_fact: Before CMGE, Xiao founded mobile game developer Huiyou Digital (Shenzhen) in July 2007, sold to HK-listed V1 Group (Crazy Sports) in Oct 2009. He earned a law degree via online education (South China Normal Univ., 2009) and a master's in software engineering from Beihang University (2014).
notes: IR email is the shareholder-enquiry contact named in the 2021 annual report (named IR staffer); may be outdated, check latest annual report. Gaming, not energy; angle could be AI in game dev (he has discussed AI in interviews).

name: Xie Xiaomei
current_role: Director (and strategy & development committee member), Bomin Electronics Co., Ltd. (SSE: 603936), Meizhou, Guangdong
